audit.tracked_content_self_canonicalization: SHA-256 frames every tracked candidate path and bytes after blanking only audit.tracked_content_sha256 in this register.
audit.scope: Sorted stage-zero path names and strict UTF-8 contents, framed candidate-tree SHA-256 with one blanked self field, plus every recursively discovered prototype and authorized release artifact.

fan_content_policy.use_boundary: Non-TRPG fan-content distinction only; not comparator or SRD publication authority.

phb_2024.bibliography: Wizards of the Coast LLC, Player's Handbook, 2024
phb_2024.boundary: Non-SRD official bibliography only; exact pages or stable digital locators remain in accepted issue #50 and #52 audit records.

classification_definitions.srd_5_2_1_licensed_use: SRD 5.2.1 source material or required attribution used under CC BY 4.0.
classification_definitions.original_project_content: Project-authored code, policy, tests, audit language, or compact technical structure.
classification_definitions.narrow_nominative_reference: Limited unofficial reference needed to identify a source, product, publisher, or comparator.
classification_definitions.independently_expressed_factual_mechanic: Compact fact or relation expressed independently without source descriptive prose.
classification_definitions.historical_reference_in_current_document: Current tracked record describing frozen or superseded history without reactivating it.
classification_definitions.uncertain_counsel_review: Engineering evidence is insufficient for a legal disposition; qualified counsel review remains.
classification_definitions.remove_or_rename: Reference is not justified by the current audited purpose and should be removed or renamed.

reference_categories.definition: D&D, Dungeons & Dragons, and D&D Beyond names or official-domain references.
Wizards of the Coast identity, ownership shorthand, or official corporate-domain reference.
Current non-SRD Battle Master or Eldritch Knight natural or stable machine identifier.
Bounded current non-SRD comparator feat, feature, and maneuver names.
Bounded official SRD-page examples of names omitted from SRD 5.2.1.
Bounded SRD 5.2.1 replacement names identified by the official SRD page.
Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide, Monster Manual, PHB, or DMG bibliographic reference.
SRD, SRD 5.2.1, SRD machine identifier, or System Reference Document reference.
D&D Beyond Basic Rules reference, which may appear only as a rejected provenance boundary.
OGL or Open Game License reference, limited to negative or historical discussion.
Wizards Fan Content Policy name or official policy URL.
Affiliation, endorsement, sponsorship, connection, or official-status wording relevant to source and brand boundaries.
Statement about project licensing, copyright, trademark, ownership, or rights in Wizards material.
Whole-repository, blanket-license, or single-SPDX wording requiring a scoped negative disposition.
